name: Time Lord
description: You become empowered as time flows around you. Over time you gain stacks that grant Intelligence. Stacks have a maximum and are permanent.

name: Time Rift
description: Create a rift in time that deals Magical Damage to all enemies in the area. Hitting a god permanently increases Time Rift Damage by 1.

name: Accelerate
description:
Accelerate yourself for a duration. You gain Movement Speed (initial plus increasing over time) and increased Attack Speed. While Accelerate is active, the Wheel of Time stops; the quadrant it stopped on determines which bonus you receive:

Section I: Heal based on your max Health over time.
Section II: Abilities cost no Mana.
Section III: Increased Intelligence.
Section IV: Increased Intelligence contribution to your Attacks.

name: Stop Time
description: Fire spinning gears of time forward. Enemies hit have their Attack Speed reduced, ramping into a Stun. They take Magical Damage on impact and Magical Damage when Stunned.

name: Rewind
description:
Teleport through time to a recent position, restoring your Health and Mana to their earlier values. All of your Cooldowns reset instantly.

• You become CC Immune while Rewind prepares
• The Heal is not affected by Healing Reduction

name: Chronos Basic Attack
description: Fire a projectile that deals Magical Damage to the first enemy hit.
